moat_against: ROIC proxy only 7.60% at its 2025 peak after -2.2% in 2020 — never well above cost of capital through a cycle
Structurally thin ~4.3% operating margin; food and labor inflation passes through only with a lag
Contracts rebid competitively every 3-5 years; Compass Group competes with greater global scale
High leverage: net debt $4,766,842,000 at FY2025 end, 13.06x the TTM OE base, plus $316,049,000 of lease liabilities
Cyclical volumes — OE/share was -$1.08 in FY2020; labor-intensive model with persistent wage pressure
moat_for: Top-3 US contract-catering scale with Avendra group-purchasing leverage (>$1.1B annualized new spend added fiscal YTD 2026)
Record client retention near 98% (Q3 FY2026) and $1.6B net-new business fiscal YTD, up 51%
Operating margin expanding steadily: 3.03% (2022) to 4.28% (2025), 4.39% TTM (fundamentals.json)
Diversified verticals (education, healthcare, B&I, sports/entertainment, corrections) plus first-mover Aramark Nexus data-center hospitality platform
moat_justification: Real scale and retention in a top-3 US contract-catering oligopoly (Avendra purchasing leverage, record ~98% client retention in Q3 FY2026, $1.6B net-new business fiscal YTD, steady operating-margin expansion 3.03% in 2022 to 4.28% in 2025 and 4.39% TTM), but contracts are competitively rebid every 3-5 years, Compass Group is larger, margins are structurally thin (~4.3% operating), and the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json has never been well above the cost of capital through a cycle (-2.2% in 2020, 1.57% in 2021, 3.37% in 2022, 5.88% in 2023, 6.64% in 2024, 7.60% in 2025); gross margin as filed collapses to operating income, so the thin operating margin is the margin evidence. CAP 7.2y.
name: Aramark
one_liner: Improving contract food/facilities operator with scale and record ~98% retention but thin ~4.3% operating margins and ROIC only just reaching 7.6%, moat 4/10 — at $55.28 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 5.98%, weighted IV@15% $14.60; even the super-bull case is 9.02%); it clears 15% only at ~$14.60.
sector: Consumer Services / Food & Facilities Services (contract catering)
